field_principles.code_confidence_baseline_auroc: Headroom check: a baseline near 1.0 means no room to discriminate, so a null is uninformative.
field_principles.code_corpus_name: Which labeled code benchmark was scored -- provenance.
field_principles.code_corpus_path: Where the labeled code corpus lives -- the apparatus exp3642 reuses for the code row.
field_principles.code_verifiers_fire: BARE bool. True iff the execution-applicable verifiers scored (n_scored>0, variance>0) -- distinguishes 'transfer failed' from 'verifiers never ran'. STORE AS BARE true/false.
field_principles.execution_verifier_auroc: The execution-applicable verifiers' standalone code-error signal + CI.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Scores cached code candidates with local verifiers; no LLM load.
field_principles.math_signal_code_auroc: The transferred FoVer-math verifier signal on code -- the core transfer number.
field_principles.transfer_delta_vs_literature: Signed comparison to the +4-8pt arXiv:2506.00027 anchor -- contextualizes Carnot vs the published positive control.
